about: NOT A CAPTURE. Lines in the shape of Claude Code's stream-json output for a turn that reaches the login's usage limit, for test/engine/handoff.test.ts until scripts/capture-claude-rate-limit.ts has recorded a real one. A rejected rate_limit_event has not been observed live: no file under test/recordings/ holds one. The rate_limit_event line has exactly the fields parseClaudeLine in src/drivers/claude-code.ts reads (rate_limit_info.status and rate_limit_info.resetsAt, in seconds since 1970), as in the allowed events the CLI printed in real sessions (test/recordings/ask-question.json, chat-fetch.json), with status rejected. The system init and result lines have the fields the parser reads for a session's start and a turn that ended in error. Which error result the CLI prints after a rejected event is not known; the driver marks any turn that ends in error after one as ended on the usage limit (limitedEnd).
